=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:~180-215 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_remove_issue_label_if_present` wraps `gh api -X DELETE` in `gh_retry`, so missing labels trigger repeated retries on 404s.
  WHY: This wastes API quota and adds latency during phase transitions because most labels are absent; reviewers agree on the same root cause and highest reported confidence is 5.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3554-4407 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, minimax_minimax-m2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback `_remove_issue_label_if_present` copies in the workflow duplicate the same retry-on-404 behavior.
  WHY: The fallback path will keep making unnecessary retried DELETE calls for absent labels, so the same inefficiency persists wherever the helper is duplicated.
- .ai/review_issue_ledger.txt:entire file | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: `.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt` is a runtime artifact that is tracked in the repository.
  WHY: Keeping a mutable review-state ledger version-controlled creates noisy diffs and can cause stale or conflicting state to be committed.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:Test execution steps | severity=medium | confidence=[4,5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new contract tests are not executed in CI.
  WHY: Regressions in the label-helper and PR-status fallback contracts would not be caught automatically; reviewers reported the gap with confidence 4 and 5.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:167 | severity=medium | confidence=[3,4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The `sed` URL-encoding fallback does not encode all URL-reserved characters.
  WHY: Labels containing additional reserved characters can produce malformed API URLs when `jq` is unavailable; reviewer confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3596-3606,3756-3766,4407-4417 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The `if ! source scripts/label_helpers.sh; then ... fi` blocks are brittle when the sourced helper is incompatible.
  WHY: If sourcing succeeds but the helper is not actually usable, the workflow can be left without a robust fallback; this was only raised by one reviewer at confidence 4.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:~160-210 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Retries DELETE API calls on 404 errors (label not present) via `gh_retry`.
  WHY: Each missing label triggers up to 5 retried API calls during phase transitions, causing unnecessary API load and delays

- .ai/review_issue_ledger.txt:Entire file | severity=medium | confidence=4

  WHY: Creates noisy diffs in PRs, could interfere with intended review/autofix flow which expects this as runtime-only artifact.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:167 | severity=medium | confidence=3

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function wraps the label deletion API call in `gh_retry` (which defaults to 5 attempts). When rotating through the catalog of ~17 phase labels, labels that are already absent return a 404. `gh_retry` sees the non-zero exit and retries the deletion, even though a 404 for an absent label is terminal and successful for the purpose of ensuring it is gone.
  WHY: Every phase transition (e.g., to `ai:ready-to-merge`) triggers up to 16 unnecessary retried DELETE calls. This adds significant latency to the workflow, wastes GitHub API quota, and increases the risk of hitting secondary rate limits.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback functions in the `review_autofix.yml` workflow duplicate the same inefficient retry logic found in `scripts/label_helpers.sh`.
  WHY: Even if the external script is fixed, these inline copies will continue to spam the API with retries on 404s during label cleanup in the `Mark linked issues ready to merge`, `Review-blocked judge decision`, and `Finalize merge` steps.
- scripts/label_helpers.sh | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `sed` fallback only encodes `%`, `:`, `/`, and spaces. It misses other URL-reserved characters (e.g., `+`, `&`, `#`, `?`).
  WHY: If a user or automation creates a label name containing other reserved characters and `jq` is unavailable in the environment, the resulting API URL for label deletion will be malformed, causing the deletion to fail or target the wrong resource.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The current logic removes the local fallback definitions if the `source` command succeeds. However, if the sourced file is present but contains an incompatible version of the function (or the source fails silently later), the environment is left without a working helper.
  WHY: It makes the workflow brittle. A more robust pattern would be to define the fallbacks FIRST and then let the `source` command overwrite them if the external script is available.
- .ai/review_issue_ledger.txt | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: A runtime state artifact (`.ai/review_issue_ledger.txt`) is being tracked/committed in the repository.
  WHY: This file is intended for cross-iteration state within a single PR run. Committing it to the repo creates "noise" in the PR diff and can lead to merge conflicts or stale ledger data being pulled into other PRs if not carefully managed. It should be handled as a temporary artifact or added to `.gitignore`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:185 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The DELETE call to remove a label is wrapped in `gh_retry`, which causes unnecessary retries when the label is already absent. When a label doesn't exist on an issue, the GitHub API returns 404. The function does have internal 404 handling (lines 195-197), but `gh_retry` retries the failed call multiple times (default 5 retries with exponential backoff) before that internal check can run.
  WHY: Every phase transition loops through all known phase labels and calls `_remove_issue_remain_ if_present` for each one. Since most labels won't be present, each absent label triggers 5 retry attempts before the 404 check catches it, resulting in dozens of wasted API calls per transition.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The three inline fallback copies of `_remove_issue_remain_ if_present` have the same issue - the DELETE call is wrapped in `gh_retry`, causing unnecessary retries when labels are absent. Same root cause as above, replicated in three locations.
  WHY: Same behavior as above - every phase transition through the fallback helpers triggers repeated unnecessary API calls for each absent label.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/label_helpers.sh:~180-215 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function calls `gh_retry gh api -X DELETE` without first checking whether the label exists on the issue. It retries up to 5 times on 404s (label not found), wasting API quota and adding latency during phase transitions where non-existent labels are common.
  WHY: Unnecessary GitHub API retries on every phase change when the target label isn't present; can hit rate limits under heavy load and slow down workflows.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:~3713-3744 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inline fallback helper defined inside the workflow uses the same `gh_retry` DELETE logic without a pre-check.
  WHY: The API waste occurs even when the sourced `scripts/label_helpers.sh` is unavailable; the fallback path is affected identically.
- .ai/review_issue_ledger.txt (tracked) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The ledger file is a runtime artifact that changes every autofix iteration and remains tracked in the repository.
  WHY: It causes noisy commits and potential interference with review flow because this transient file should not be version-controlled.
- tests/test_label_helpers_phase_transition_contract.py, tests/test_issue_pr_status_payload_fallback_contract.py | severity=medium | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: These unit tests exist but are not executed in CI.
  WHY: Regressions in critical label transition and payload-fallback behavior could reach production because the coverage gap is not enforced.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
